dedupe_keys.name: topologie des stations de velos en libre service

description: Topologie des stations de vélos en libre-service is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Liste des stations de vélos en libre-service du réseau STAR, comprenant notamment leur nom, le nombre d'emplacements et la géolocalisation. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are vélo. The portal shows 57 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2016-06-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
